name: routines
description: The trigger lane: schedules that fire a procedure the stack already ships, never a procedure of their own. A catalog of six routine definitions — package update, merge review, change report, devbook check, security review, and technology graph refresh — each naming the skill it runs, the plugins that skill needs, a cadence, and the prompt for a cloud session that starts with nothing but the repository. routine-sync creates or updates them through whatever scheduler the live session exposes and records the selection under components.routines; routine-status reads their runs and logs; routine-run fires one now. Declares no dependency and names four plugins: a routine whose target is not enabled is reported and skipped, never scheduled.
